info.name: Matomo Reporting API for plugin Roll Up Reporting API
info.description: Provides API endpoints for managing roll-up websites and their source site assignments. Use these methods to create roll-ups, update their configuration, and list the configured roll-up sites with their assigned source websites.

item.name: Roll up reporting add roll up

query.description: Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.
(Required) The name of the roll-up website.
(Required) Source website IDs to assign to the roll-up. Accepts numeric site IDs and the special value 'all' to assign all websites.
(Required) The timezone to apply to the roll-up website.
(Required) The currency code to apply to the roll-up website.

response.name:
The numeric ID of the created roll-up website.

Example responses require Super User access. Use Try it out to see a live response.

item.name: Roll up reporting update roll up

query.description: Response format. Defaults to `xml`. Use `original` to get the original PHP data structure.
(Required) The numeric ID of the roll-up website to update.
The new roll-up website name. Omit to keep the current name.
Source website IDs to assign to the roll-up. Accepts numeric site IDs and the special value 'all' to assign all websites. Omit to keep the current source site assignment.
The new timezone for the roll-up website. Omit to keep the current timezone.
The new currency code for the roll-up website. Omit to keep the current currency.
